Follow [the contract](../../AGENTS.md) and [protocol](../../docs/agents.md).
Keep private HR data separate from general contact access. Test calendars,
timezones, balances, approvals and offboarding. Use synthetic applicants/payroll.
Payroll calculation/legal correctness needs professional review; build only
approved provider contracts. No real payslip delivery, payroll execution or
employee changes. Hand off candidate evidence for independent QA.
